

# Loading necessary libraries. 
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
set.seed(123)

library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(vegan)
library(microbiome)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggpubr)
library(CooccurrenceAffinity)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
```


#Setting up variables for directories and files. 
```{r}
##Setting up variables for the relevant directories.
SCRIPT_DIR <- getwd()
setwd(SCRIPT_DIR)

#Results
NETWORK_DIR <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "Correlation_networks")
FASTSPAR_R_DIR <- file.path(NETWORK_DIR, "R_Networks_results")

#Results separated in figures and tables.
FIGURES_OUT_DIR <- file.path(FASTSPAR_R_DIR, "Figures")
TABLES_OUT_DIR <- file.path(FASTSPAR_R_DIR, "Tables")

#Files that can be used to visualize the network in Gephi
GEPHI_DIR <-file.path(FASTSPAR_R_DIR, "Gephi")


###Create output directories
dir.create(FASTSPAR_R_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(FIGURES_OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(TABLES_OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(GEPHI_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```
